name: Hyo Jee Kang
abstract_title: Improvisational Transcendence: Phenomenology and Neurocognitive Dynamics of Pain Dissolution and Self-Loss during Musical Improvisation
abstract: This paper explores the phenomenology and neurodynamics of transcendental experience during musical improvisation, based entirely on the first-person experience of the author, a classical pianist, improviser, and composer, who uniquely completed 15 repeated sessions of randomized performance conditions. notable: Created 'LOOKING-MIND' performance combining Bach with real-time fNIRS brain visualization
notes: Pianist, composer, and researcher. Uses fNIRS to measure prefrontal cortex activation.
